author: codex
text: Key thesis result for this case: direct mode achieved NiFi import success with zero validation errors, but did not achieve functional readiness without manual semantic correction. The generated runtime values were wrong for the current stand (jdbc database mydb, password postgres) and maximum-value-columns was set to id although public.orders has no id column. This run demonstrates that PCT success is not sufficient as the only quality metric.
